records.issue_text: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:147 — Destination calendars without credentialId now fall back to primary, placing legacy users’ bookings in the wrong Google calendar.
records.rationale: The diff replaces `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.externalId` with `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId || "primary"`. If a destination calendar entry lacks a credentialId (or its credentialId doesn't match the passed credential), the find returns undefined and the event is created on 'primary' instead of the user's selected destination calendar — a behavior change visible directly in the diff for the no-match case. Plausible and grounded, though impact depends on callers always passing matching credentialIds.
